name: Sheet Pan Black Bean Burger with Cheese, Guacamole, Salsa & Sweet Potato Fries

ingredients.name: black bean veggie burger patty, frozen
julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional).
When the oven is heated, transfer fries to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake until starting to turn golden, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (20 oz) bag julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheet from the oven and flip fries. Return to the oven and continue to bake until fries are golden and crispy, 10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, arrange burger patties on one side of another large baking sheet. Add to the oven and bake until partially warmed through, about 5 minutes.
Remove burger patties from the oven and, using a spatula, gently turn them over. Top each patty with ¼-cup of cheese.

Split buns in half and add to the other side of the baking sheet with the patties, arranging them cut-side up. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until patties are heated through, cheese is melted, and buns are lightly toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and separate lettuce leaves.

To serve, place bottom half of each bun on a plate; spread with 2 tbsp guacamole, then layer with lettuce, a cheesy burger patty, 2 more tbsp guacamole, and 2 tbsp salsa. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with fries. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup guacamole
½ cup fresh salsa
